annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires that an endpoint, upon receiving a STOP_SENDING frame on a stream already in the Data Sent state and wishing to cease retransmission of previously-sent STREAM frames, must first send a RESET_STREAM frame. No alternative materially different implementation behaviour is supported by the wording, and no missing constraint is evident.
